_notes: Copy to config.json. Only keys you want to change need to be here; the rest use defaults in bay_occupancy.py. min_box_area_frac = smallest truck box (fraction of the whole frame) that counts. *_confirm_count = consecutive rounds that must agree before a bay flips state (empty is higher so one missed detection can't flap it). crop = pixels trimmed from each edge before detection (a camera in cameras.json can have its own "crop" to override). save_images keeps only the newest image per bay as <bay>_<status>_<YYYYmmdd_HHMMSS>.jpg in save_dir (refreshed every save_interval_sec and immediately on a status change). webhook: GET http://host:8081/bay/<bay> returns {status, timestamp, status_since, snapshot_base64 (JPEG downscaled to max_dimension)}; ?image=0 omits the image, /bays lists all. event_images_dir keeps a snapshot at each arrival/departure (named <bay>_<status>_<time>.jpg, pruned after event_images_keep_days; "" disables) -- the dashboard shows them on each truck entry. external: when enabled, <base_url>/api/bay-status is only compared with the camera. Bay entries come from the camera alone; an API reading is recorded as site_api agrees/disagrees on the webhook and is otherwise ignored. events_csv logs every confirmed status change (timestamp, bay, status, previous_status, previous_duration_sec, class, confidence); "" disables. MQTT publishes only on a confirmed change, retained, to <topic_prefix>/<bay>.
dashboard_note: dashboard.bay_webhook_url = where bay_occupancy.py serves /bay/<bay> (default http://127.0.0.1:8081); the bay page shows that live frame.
